findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources (*), which is effectively over-permissive administrative access rather than least privilege. This violates the least privilege principle and expands the attack surface if the credentials are compromised.

Creates a long-lived static IAM access key for the user with no rotation mechanism. Static access keys persist until manually rotated and are a recurring source of credential compromise per the security guidance, which prefers temporary credentials or federation.
